WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    COUNT(*) as track_count,
    CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS REAL) as rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT 
  mtr.Name,
  mtr.rate,
  mtr.track_count,
  mtr.rate - ar.avg_rate as above_average
FROM media_type_rates mtr
CROSS JOIN average_rate ar
WHERE mtr.rate > ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY mtr.rate DESC
